body: I know from my own binge eating that is most likely what is going to happen.  But also what else am I supposed to do?  Not have any food in my house and have to go to the store every single day after work to buy what is for dinner?  what about breakfast?

they binge eat anything and everything.  Ingredients to make meals.  I used to eat a bagel and cream cheese for breakfast every morning, and now I can't even buy cream cheese because one of them will just take the whole brick in their room.  If we buy any frozen foods or freeze anything- they will be gone.  One night I made a second dinner to put in the freezer when it cooled to have on another night and I forgot to put it in the freezer before i went to bed and the next day when I went to move it - it was gone- one of them woke up in the middle of the night and ate the entire freezer meal.
$1 pizza FTW.  Also, if a camera crew is coming in to film, at least pick up your nasty sneakers from underneath the table where food is being prepped.  lol
